mechanism: Spot grid downside inventory: test an observable long-trend gate.034 informs hypothesis; adaptive exploration, not fresh OOS.
gate: Each completed UTC daily close enables iff close>=mean(last120 completed daily closes). Missing warmup disables. Active off cancels grid after decision and targets cash>=1h later. No future drawdown or smoothed labels.
control_interpretation: Half tests simple risk reduction; hold isolates directional exposure; entry_only gates NEW grids but keeps existing until original reset, then liquidates if off. Never select control by performance.
execution: One cash/inventory account, original penetration/onefill percell/hour; first intent TTL12H, no zero-volume fills, risk stop overrides reset; no grid fills while pendingreset/stop. Hold5pp band enabled, all tradable residual off. All exits/reentry/reset costs. No leverage/funding.
primary_metric: Daily utility proxy r-1.5*r^2 (gamma3 research scenario, not PM risk preference or exact certainty equivalent); G120 minus C0 and C1 on stitched2024-2025; paired7/14/30day calendar block bootstrap2000 seed20261021.
secondary: All net returns/vol/drawdown/exposure/cost/turnover byperiod/scenario; C2 isolates grid vsdirection, C3 active exits; no threshold/grid/horizon search.
historical_support: Base aggregate netpositive and drawdown<=35%; lower5% utility increment>0 vsBOTH C0/C1 for allblocks; mean utility increment positive vsboth stress/delay and known2026H1. No requirement absolute profitable everyyear. At best historical candidate, no automatic research/Demo qualification.
